title: Kopi Shift
tagline: Some words you pour. Some words you leave out.
hook: Order typography travels into the cup; Kosong leaves a visible empty sugar space.
gesture: Drag a labelled pot, sugar box or evaporated-milk tin into a cup; stir with the spoon. Click-then-cup and keyboard equivalents.
scope: One cut-paper counter, two cups, three ingredient categories, Kopi-O Kosong and Kopi-C plus optional Kopi-O transfer; no timer.
risk: Negative-space metaphor can blur O versus Kosong; fixed laptop diorama is small on phones; cross-device board sync unverified.
recommendation: Build Word Cast Counter: protect the typography-to-ingredient pour and Kosong omission before adding voice, AI or later lessons.
